summary: A search for a campaign's audience is held at the provider — paused, out of credits or at the plan's limit — with what it was asked for, found and landed; said when a read first reports the hold, and again only after the search moves and holds again; a default manager trigger.

key.description: The read that first said the search is held, by its work item: one line per hold.

audience.description: The audience the search runs under.

plugin.description: The plugin the search runs at.

state.description: What holds it: a person paused it at the provider, the account's credits ran out, or the account's plan holds no more contacts. Each holds the search until a person acts at the provider, and the runtime goes on reading it on the slower cadence of a held search.

asked.description: How many people the search was asked for.

found.description: How many the provider said it found, or null where it never said.

landed.description: How many members of the campaign the search made so far.
